scope: real Chrome against loopback Node full-stack candidate using synthetic/de-identified QA text only
regression_found_and_fixed: Initial real-browser replay found an async form bug caused by using Event.currentTarget after await; company/advisory handlers now capture the form before await and the final browser flow was replayed successfully.
agent_transport_fix: Real browser QA also exposed that a separate file-process runner could leave the live server's in-memory FileStore stale. The daily runner now prefers a restricted bearer-authenticated live Agent API; direct file mode requires explicit --service-stopped.
claim_boundary: This verifies the local final v0.7.1 candidate, not ChatGPT Sites platform storage, identity or scheduler behavior.
